consequence.statement: Environments that were hitting the failure caused by GitHub's deprecation of the use of status checks stop failing once upgraded to 0.16.0; the evidence states no operator action beyond upgrading.
consequence.remediation: Upgrade to 0.16.0; the evidence states no operator action beyond upgrading.

assertion.statement: external-secrets 0.16.0 fixes a failure that occurred because GitHub deprecated the use of status checks.

proposal.undeterminedReason: applicability: the release note only states that a failure caused by GitHub's deprecation of the use of status checks was fixed; it does not state which provider, configuration, resource or workload exercised the deprecated status-checks usage, so no exposure condition can be written from the evidence without inventing field paths or provider names
